title: End moments at the imposed whole-specimen positions (600 N, 10 deg AR, flexion/extension)

quantity.name: end moment
quantity.definition: moment measured by the load cell at the end positions, mean (SD); AR one side

source.authors: Steffen T, Baramki HG, Rubin R, Antoniou J, Aebi M
source.sample: human cadaver lumbar L1-S1 spines (L1-L2 and L5-S1 fused with screws), Thompson grade II (13) / III (3); 16 specimens (L1-S1 spines; L3-L4 disc instrumented; 1 grade IV disc excluded per text)

protocol.summary: L1-S1 spine, L1/L2 and L5/S1 fused, ends in plaster with L3/L4 disc parallel to fixtures; 6-DOF custom machine: upper platform displacement-controlled (compression, AR, FE), lower platform free in LB and both horizontal translations. 300 N held 15 min, then 600 N axial compression with whole-specimen positions upright, 15 deg flexion, 10 deg extension; at each, 10 deg axial rotation to each side (whole specimen); 2 preconditioning cycles, then a recording cycle (left-to-right and right-to-left, averaged). IDP: three 2.1 mm needles in the mid-plane of L3/L4 (anterior mid-sagittal; left and right posterolateral at 30 deg to sagittal plane), each with three 1.6 mm strain-gauge transducers 6, 9, 12 mm from the outer disc border facing upward. Absolute pressure (kPa), mean (SEM).
how_to_simulate: Model L1-S1 (or L2-L5 with rigid ends) with L3/L4 disc horizontal; apply 600 N axial compression on the upper end.

Impose whole-specimen sagittal posture (upright, 15 deg flexion, 10 deg extension) and then 10 deg axial rotation to each side (displacement control; lateral bending and horizontal translations free).
Report L3/L4 segmental axial rotation (one side) and sagittal angle, and the end moments, for comparison with Table 3.
protocol.notes: Sensor tissue zones (Table 4, n=16): anterior needle 12 mm: 13 nuclear/3 intermediate/0 annular; 9 mm: 0/9/7; 6 mm: 0/0/16. PL left 12 mm: 16/0/0; 9 mm: 7/7/2; 6 mm: 0/1/15. PL right 12 mm: 15/1/0; 9 mm: 9/6/1; 6 mm: 0/2/14. Needle insertion (0.08 ml) estimated to add ~26 kPa. Pressure gradients (Fig 5) and differences vs upright (Fig 6) not extracted.

data.load: 15 deg flexion, 600 N, 10 deg whole-specimen AR
10 deg extension, 600 N, 10 deg whole-specimen AR

extraction.check_notes: Re-read; 'nm' in table header read as Nm.
